set.body:
Outcome: run a frozen, local, question-conditioned claim assessment comparison on retained audio/caption inputs and consume attributed proposals in ClaimAssessmentReceipt. This is the next owner-authorized milestone after bd-01M5FGET6020C9B1BC2YCBKY52.
Scope: fixed atomic questions, independently frozen input-level support/counter/unknown judgments, audio-only/caption-only/combined and optional human-text arms. Preserve physical source provenance, quote ownership, unknown/failure denominators and unchanged event mapping. Same-film development only; no claim of free-form recall extraction, calibrated veridicality, end-to-end annotation-free segmentation or population accuracy.
Proposed change: offline local model experiment harness and test-only Scala receipt adapter, with synthetic contract tests. No production scorer/captioner change or new dependency/public ontology.
Acceptance: frozen labels before model output, executed local model receipts, false support/false contradiction and unresolved coverage by arm, known Sherlock body diagnostic separately, exact-SHA independent review, scoped gates and compiled guard mutation. All corpus text remains ignored/local. No merge/push.
Next: independent formulation review, freeze bounded cases and prompts, implement harness and receipt consumer.
set.title: Qualify automatic claim assessment over frozen audiovisual evidence
